description: Access design files, team projects, and design collaboration data. Use the available design information or image outputs to prepare visual-content work and coordinate design tasks. Start from a specific design objective, check the relevant file, template, or image context, and review the result against content and delivery requirements. Preview material before publication or handoff to confirm that text, brand elements, dimensions, and visual details match the intended use.
description_cn: 访问设计文件、团队项目及设计协作信息。适合在设计协作和视觉内容制作中组织素材与工作输入。可围绕具体设计目标核对文件、模板或图片信息，再检查处理结果是否满足尺寸、内容和交付要求。对需要发布的视觉内容，应在导出或使用前进行人工预览，确认文字、品牌元素和画面细节符合预期。
